chosen_edition: Walter C. Smith, Hymns of Christ and the Christian Life (1867), p. 210

editorial.method: Human word-for-word comparison against the chosen edition required

notes: Smith's original six four-line stanzas (pp. 210-211, Macmillan 1867, in 'Hymns of the Holy Trinity'), headed by the epigraph 1 Tim. i. 17 rather than a title; the epigraph is omitted. Differs from modern hymnals: 'Thy Justice like mountains', 'To all life Thou givest, both great and small', 'nought changeth Thee', plus the original fourth and sixth stanzas ('To-day and To-morrow...' and 'Through Christ in the story, and Christ in the soul'); a stray double period after 'heart' in the scan is normalized to one.
